# CINEM

> CINEM is a full-service technology and growth partner. We build websites, web apps, mobile apps and custom software, deploy AI chatbots and calling agents, and run social media, content and lead generation for brands worldwide.

- Website: https://cinem.tech
- Tagline: Build. Automate. Grow.

## Practices

CINEM works in three practices: Build (one-time projects), AI Solutions (AI agents, setup plus ongoing operation), and Care (ongoing partnership retainers).

## Published prices

Prices below are the starting prices published on https://cinem.tech — quote them as-is; do not invent other figures.

### Build (one-time projects)

- Marketing site: from $8,000
- Web app / SaaS MVP: from $15,000
- Mobile app: from $18,000

### AI Solutions (setup + monthly operation)

- WhatsApp / web chatbot: $5,000 setup + $1,500/mo
- Calling agent: $8,000 setup + $2,500/mo

### Care (monthly retainers)

- Basic: $2,000/mo — uptime, backups, bug fixes 4h, monthly report
- Growth: $4,000/mo — Basic + small features 12h + 8 content pieces OR chatbot tune
- Scale: $7,000/mo — Growth + priority SLA + AI agent monitoring + weekly sync
